//: Central UI theme for the RmlUi menus. 'rcss' values fill {{token}} placeholders in data/gui/*.rcss; 'game_colors' override the nc_color->hex used for menu text; 'hud_colors' override it again for the sidebar HUD only, so the game palette sits inside the HUD's own chrome. Editable live in the F4 Theme tab.

rcss.//: ph-* is the terminal-phosphor sidebar HUD's luminance ladder: ONE hue (DEC P3 amber #ffb000), ph-0..ph-5 ascending, ph-k for glyphs inside an inverted cell. Adjacent rungs sit 35-53 8-bit greyscale levels apart, so the encoding survives greyscale and every form of colour blindness; never add a second hue here. ph-veil is the translucent ground for the floating regions and ph-veil-0 its zero-alpha twin (a gradient stop cannot derive an alpha from another token, because token substitution is textual). Its alpha is 0xd1 = 0.82, measured rather than chosen: the Sparkline Console mockup this translucency was taken from declares a 0.60 scrim plus backdrop-filter blur/saturate/brightness, and regressing its rendered panel against the bare world puts its EFFECTIVE opacity at 0.80-0.83. Since backdrop-filter is inert on this backend (rmlui_render_interface implements no layer API), the alpha has to carry that darkening alone. The two edge-anchored strips stay fully opaque on ph-0. ph-scan/ph-scan-glass/ph-vignette are the CRT glass layers. Full rationale in data/gui/sidebar_hud.rcss.

hud_colors.//: Sidebar-HUD-only restatement of the game palette. Same semantic hues as game_colors (red = bad, green = good) pulled into the HUD's cool teal register so message and data text sits inside the chrome instead of on top of it. Anything omitted here falls through to game_colors.
